name: payments-api

dependencies.name: payment-gateway
dependencies.description: Authorizes each hosted-checkout payment (mobile money or card, by channel) and reports its outcome.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends payment confirmation and failure receipts to customers and merchants.

dependencies.name: payout-service
dependencies.description: Disburses a merchant's daily payout to its linked bank account.

description: The backend for merchant onboarding/KYC, hosted payment links, checkout, transaction history, bank accounts, payouts and admin oversight. Owns all business data and every business rule; the three web apps are thin clients over it. Does not render any UI and does not talk to a payment or payout provider directly for anything other than authorizing a checkout payment or triggering a payout.
